verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is explicitly open source with no forced API keys/paywalls, distributed via GitHub, and supports Dockerized self-hosting with a FastAPI server, plus community-documented self-hosting guides (Docker, n8n, MCP for Cursor/Claude) corroborating real-world self-hosted deployments. missing for 10: independent benchmark/uptime evidence of large-scale self-hosted production use.
